0.clinical_meaning: Healthy individual / No blast cells present

1.clinical_meaning: ALL patient / At least one blast cell present

all_idb1.dataset_nature: Whole-slide microscopic field classification and blast centroid localization

0.clinical_meaning: Normal lymphocyte / Non-blast cell from healthy individual

1.clinical_meaning: Lymphoblast / ALL leukemia blast cell from ALL patient

all_idb2.dataset_nature: Cropped single-cell classification benchmark (centered single cell)

cross_dataset_relationship.crop_origin_analysis: ALL_IDB2 consists of single-cell bounding crops extracted directly from the whole-microscopic frames of ALL_IDB1.
cross_dataset_relationship.leakage_warning: CRITICAL: ALL_IDB1 and ALL_IDB2 share underlying patients and image scenes. ALL_IDB2 cells are sub-crops of ALL_IDB1 images. Mixing them into train/test without tracking provenance will cause data leakage. They must be evaluated and trained on separate, controlled pipelines.
cross_dataset_relationship.recommended_primary_classification_datas: ALL_IDB2 is specifically designed, standardized, and benchmarked for single-cell CNN classification (130 normal vs 130 blast, centered 257x257 cells), directly matching SmartCell's cell-level classification architecture.

patient_id_analysis.filename_format: ImXXX_Y where XXX is sequential counter and Y is class label
patient_id_analysis.metadata_status: No patient IDs or patient-level grouping tables are present in the dataset directories or official text files. The original publication (Scotti et al.) anonymized patient IDs.
patient_id_analysis.split_implication: Since explicit patient IDs are unavailable, a class-stratified split with fixed random seed (42) and deduplication must be used, with this limitation explicitly documented.

classification_vs_segmentation.all_idb1: Binary slide classification + point centroid localization. (No segmentation masks or polygon contours)
classification_vs_segmentation.all_idb2: Binary single-cell classification. (No segmentation masks or polygon contours)

ground_truth_verification.method: Directly extracted from authoritative dataset readme files and official file naming convention verified against centroid annotations
